checkout_feedback_fix.what: A plan click wrote its only status after every plan grid, so a sign-in requirement, a blocked PayPal tab, or an error looked like a dead button; duplicate plan ids in the two regional bands could also light the wrong card.
checkout_feedback_fix.proof: A live Chrome drive on 2026-11-25 clicked Starter while signed in, created a PayPal order, and opened the approval handoff; a signed-out click produced no message in the buyer's viewport because the only status paragraph sat after both plan grids. After PR #455 deployed in run 45541631054, a production 390px Chrome drive with billing and funnel requests blocked showed exactly one sign-in message inside the clicked Starter card, a Masuk dulu link, unique heading ids across both bands, and one always-mounted announcer. Five synthetic buy.click rows from the live verification were deleted; settled revenue remains $0.00.
checkout_feedback_fix.fix: site/app/lib/checkout-feedback.ts selects sign-in, pending, warning, and ordinary feedback and keys it to the clicked card; site/app/routes/harga.tsx renders it under that card, one always-mounted plan announcer, and a page-level fallback when a region change removes the card. PR #455 was deployed in run 45541631054. Pinned by decisions.json -> site-checkout-feedback-02 and state-machines.json -> checkout-plan-feedback.
